about: The recordly-demo runbook as data: every step with its command, outputs, PASS gate and on-FAIL rule. scripts/runbook.cjs reads it (status | next | show | run | check | mark | selftest); references/runbook.md is the same runbook for people. Commands run in bash after `source $SCRATCH/demo.env` (steps with preEnv run before it exists). kind: auto (the gate decides), manual (you do the work; the gate checks it), long (run through bg.sh), by-eye / by-ear / approval / send (closed only by `runbook.cjs mark`, never by a script). path: all | nodesk (a site with no desk) | desk | narrated.

steps.title: Check the machine
steps.onFail: Apply each printed remedy. Browsers, apt packages and global npm installs only with the user's OK; never playwright install on your own. Re-run S0.

steps.title: Build the voice venv (Kokoro + faster-whisper)
steps.onFail: Re-run once (a network blip). A second failure: send the user the log; never disable TLS or unset the proxy.

steps.title: Write the run's variables (demo.env)
steps.command: bash "$S/scripts/env.sh" --slug <client-slug> --scratch <absolute scratch dir outside the repo> [--desk clients/<slug>-desk]
steps.onFail: Fix the variable it names. Then `source <scratch>/demo.env` at the top of EVERY later command (variables do not survive between calls).

steps.title: Facts and client-inputs.json
steps.onFail: Fill each listed key from the site's business.ts fields sourced OWNER or TXDMV, character for character. An unconfirmed fact is asked of the user, never guessed. Leave loader, word, introKey and brand.mark null (A3 measures them).

steps.title: Build the site with the Admin link and serve it on :5183
steps.onFail: Port taken: site-server.sh stop (yours) or wait (someone else's). Never another port. A build error is the site's: tell the user.

steps.title: Measure the site, check the inputs
steps.onFail: "Open Now" FAIL: the clock must be Wednesday 2026-09-30 14:00 local (or the next open weekday). Fix each listed key, re-run A3.

steps.title: Capture self-test (a new site or machine)
steps.onFail: Determinism FAIL: re-run once when the load average is under the core count (setup.sh --check prints it; lesson B12). A second FAIL: stop and send the user the log.

steps.title: Create the project (template, assets, filled files, npm ci)
steps.onFail: npm ci failed: send the user the error. Never npm install. An existing project: --force only when re-creating it on purpose.

steps.title: Adapt and preflight the site storyboard (loop until clean)
steps.command: node "$S/scripts/measure-site.cjs" --storyboard "$P/storyboard.json" --rects --into "$I"; node "$S/scripts/fill-client.cjs" storyboard "$I" "$S/assets/storyboard-dealer-site.json" --out "$P/storyboard.json"; node "$S/scripts/fill-client.cjs" readme "$I" "$S/assets/project-README.md" --out "$P/README.md"; node "$S/scripts/measure-site.cjs" --storyboard "$P/storyboard.json"
steps.onFail: Copy each SUGGEST line into client-inputs.json → storyboard and run A5 again. After 5 rounds without PREFLIGHT CLEAN, stop and send the user the preflight output.

steps.title: Capture the five site shots, in order
steps.onFail: Re-capture from the failed shot with --from <id> (the script refuses shot N without 1..N-1 and moves stale later captures aside).

steps.title: Check the site cuts; stop the site server
steps.onFail: A failed cut at shot N: add 15 frames of preroll to N (at most twice), re-capture N..5 (A6 --from N). Still failing: send the user the cut stills ($SCRATCH/cuts) and stop.

steps.title: Look at the part-A stills before rendering
steps.command: F=$(node "$S/scripts/verify-film.cjs" --project "$P" --plan | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>console.log(JSON.parse(s).stills.map(x=>x.frame).join(",")))') && cd "$P" && nice -n 15 node scripts/stills.cjs "$SCRATCH/stills" Demo:$F
steps.onFail: Look at every still at 100% (the hero anchor beside the headline, every zoom's framing, the cut stills, the outro). A model that cannot view images sends the stills (or a contact sheet of them) to the user and records their words with mark --by-user. Never self-certify.

steps.title: Render the site film (demo-v1) and its chat copy
steps.onFail: Killed or out of memory: render the missing ranges with --frames A-B and join them with --concat (references/harness.md).

steps.title: Verify the site film
steps.onFail: Each failed gate's fix is in references/verification.md §6. An --allow-* only with its verify-decisions.md row (mark --allow).

steps.title: The contact sheet, the zoom stills at 100%, one full watch with sound
steps.onFail: A model that cannot see or hear sends contact-sheet.png and the chat copy to the user and waits for an explicit OK (mark --by-user).

steps.title: Send the site film
steps.onFail: Attach demo-v1-chat.mp4 (<= 28 MB) and the contact sheet with your file-sending tool, paste the send note. Never send the master.

steps.title: Part B decisions: the user's onboarding choice, the demo fee, the desk clock, the demo data
steps.onFail: Ask the user, verbatim: "Film the owner's first sign-in including Your Fees (I type a fee figure you give me), or film a salesperson's first sign-in (no fees screen)?" Never choose. If they choose the owner path, tell them Your Fees is new to the film: its shots and its composition segment are made and verified on this run (a house change; render.sh refuses until the segment exists). Record partB.onboarding (and demoFee with its source), deskClock = today 14:00 local, demo.phone and demo.addressPartB (lesson B13), then mark B0 --by-user with their words.

steps.title: Start the desk on :5190 (its own process group)
steps.onFail: Port taken by your own server: desk-server.sh stop. By another: wait or ask; never another port, never npm install in the desk.

steps.title: Merge the filled desk shots into the storyboard
steps.onFail: Fill the values it names in client-inputs.json (B0).

steps.title: Desk theme and selector preflight, then a fresh desk
steps.onFail: A missing selector or label means the desk changed: read the desk's docs/verification/paperwork-pages/corridor-changes.md, update the shot in assets/storyboard-desk.json (a house template change, said in the send note), refill (B2), re-run B3.

steps.title: Capture part B and its off-camera sales on one fresh desk
steps.onFail: The script restarted the desk and tried once more already. Stop; send the user the log.

steps.title: Measure the part-B cuts; refill project.ts
steps.command: node "$S/scripts/measure-desk-cuts.cjs" --project "$P" --into "$I" && node "$S/scripts/fill-client.cjs" check "$I" --stage post && node "$S/scripts/fill-client.cjs" project "$I" --out "$P/src/project.ts"
steps.onFail: A value not found: re-capture the named shot (B4). A WARN about the 100% frame: look at the frames it names and set readbackRelease[0] by hand.

steps.title: Check every cut, parts A and B
steps.onFail: A jump-cut fails pointer/camera: the cut frames in partB.cuts or the shot's cutFrames; a first frame not painted: re-measure (B5) or re-capture. Then B6 again.

steps.title: Look at every still, parts A and B
steps.command: F=$(node "$S/scripts/verify-film.cjs" --project "$P" --plan | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>console.log(JSON.parse(s).stills.map(x=>x.frame).join(",")))') && cd "$P" && nice -n 15 node scripts/stills.cjs "$SCRATCH/stills-ab" Demo:$F
steps.onFail: The part-B list is references/verification.md §7 (privacy blurs, the pad's date, no skeleton on screen, the 130-U push). No vision: send them to the user; mark --by-user.

steps.title: Stop the desk; next-env.d.ts restored
steps.onFail: desk-server.sh stop --force. If :5190 stays taken by a server you did not start, leave it and tell the user.

steps.title: Render the film (parts A + B) and its chat copy
steps.onFail: Killed or out of memory: render.sh … --frames A-B for the missing ranges, then --concat (references/harness.md).

steps.title: Verify the film
steps.onFail: references/verification.md §6. An --allow-* needs its row first (mark B9 --allow spike:<frame> --why … --by-agent …).

steps.title: Contact sheet, zoom stills at 100%, one full watch with sound
steps.onFail: No vision or hearing: send contact-sheet.png and the chat copy to the user, wait for an explicit OK, mark --by-user.

steps.title: The chat copy is <= 28 MB with the master's frame count
steps.onFail: It lowers the bitrate once itself; still over: send the master's path, never the master.

steps.title: Send the film
steps.onFail: Attach $SLUG-demo-chat.mp4 and contact-sheet.png with your file-sending tool (SendUserFile in Claude Code), paste the send note, then mark B11 --by-agent "sent".

steps.title: Fill and fact-check the house script on this client's desk
steps.command: node "$S/scripts/fill-narration.cjs" check "$I" --desk "$DESK_DIR" && node "$S/scripts/fill-narration.cjs" lines "$I" --out "$P/narration/lines.json" && node "$S/scripts/fill-narration.cjs" script "$I" --out "$P/narration/script.md"
steps.onFail: fill-narration.cjs init $I adds the block. Walk the desk for checked.features (desk-server.sh start; desk-walk sale.cjs with a scenario; the screenshots' path in checked.how). A line the desk cannot back is cut with its reason, never softened.

steps.title: The user approves the script
steps.onFail: Send narration/script.md and wait. Voice nothing before an explicit approval (mark N2 --by-user "<their words>").

steps.title: Voice every line (Kokoro af_heart, 0.95)
steps.onFail: A missing venv: S1. Another voice or speed is refused unless client-inputs.json → voice says so with a reason.

steps.title: Transcribe back and compare
steps.onFail: Exit 2: run --model medium.en --only <ids>; if medium.en hears the line as written, --accept <id> --by medium.en --why …. Else change only the punctuation of `speak` (narration.speak) and re-voice that line (voice.py --only, at most twice), else send the clip to the user and --accept --by user with their words.

steps.title: The user approves the voiced set
steps.onFail: Send preview.mp3 and transcribe-diff.md; cut nothing until the user says yes (mark N5 --by-user).

steps.title: Levels and trims (-16 LUFS +/- 0.5, true peak <= -1.5 dBTP)
steps.onFail: LEVELS FAIL: look for a clipped or near-silent take (re-voice it), then re-run. Never edit vo-lines.ts by hand.

steps.title: The narrated demo address and the demo card
steps.onFail: demo.addressNarrated: a block number on a commercial road the Census geocoder resolves (curl 'https://geocoding.geo.census.gov/geocoder/locations/onelineaddress?address=<street, city, TX zip>&benchmark=Public_AR_Current&format=json' returns addressMatches) and no listed home. No web access: ask the user for one.

steps.title: The long-cut storyboard, filled and preflighted on the desk
steps.command: bash "$S/scripts/desk/desk-server.sh" start && node "$S/scripts/fill-client.cjs" long-storyboard "$I" --into "$P/narration/storyboard-long.json" && node "$S/scripts/measure-site.cjs" --desk --storyboard "$P/narration/storyboard-long.json" --desk-dir "$DESK_DIR" && bash "$S/scripts/desk/desk-server.sh" restart
steps.onFail: As B3: the desk changed under the storyboard; update assets/storyboard-long.template.json from the desk's corridor-changes.md, re-run N8.

steps.title: Capture 20-27 and the off-camera steps on one fresh desk
steps.onFail: The script restarted and retried once already. Stop; send the log.

steps.title: Write the plan; the plan check and the lip-to-picture gate
steps.onFail: Write src/narrated/plan.ts from THIS run's captures (examples/discount-used-cars/plan.ts is the worked one; never copy its frames) and client-inputs.json → narration.anchors; fix the line or anchor each FAIL names; an exception only with its reason.

steps.title: Stills of the narrated plan
steps.onFail: Every segment start, zoom at depth, document key landed, the phone, the outro. No vision: send them; mark --by-user.

steps.title: Render the narrated film and its chat copy (~80 min)
steps.command: bash "$S/scripts/render.sh" "$P" "$SLUG-demo-narrated" --composition Narrated --check && CRF=17 AUDIO_BITRATE=192k bash "$S/scripts/render.sh" "$P" "$SLUG-demo-narrated" --composition Narrated
steps.onFail: Chunk recovery as B8 (--frames A-B, then --concat).

steps.title: Verify the narrated film
steps.onFail: Per gate (references/narration.md §10): voice set -16 +/- 0.5 LUFS, mix -16 +/- 1, true peak <= -1.5 dBTP, frames = the plan's total, onsets on cues or lines.

steps.title: Watch it, then send the narrated film
steps.onFail: One full watch with sound first (no hearing: the user watches the chat copy and says yes). Attach the chat copy, the contact sheet and narration/lip-to-picture.md; never the master.
